external_entities.name: Member
external_entities.description: A library member using the library app or a self-service kiosk to borrow, renew, reserve, or return books.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Members borrow, renew and reserve books through the library app on their phones.

external_entities.name: Desk staff
external_entities.description: Library desk staff who manually extend loans, clear account blocks, or mark books returned.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Desk staff can extend a loan, clear a block on a member's account or mark a book as returned by hand

processes.name: Library app
processes.description: The app on a member's phone that requests loan renewals and reservations from the lending API.
processes.source_excerpt: The app on their phone calls the lending API.

processes.name: Lending API
processes.description: The REST API that applies loan rules and reads or writes loan records.
processes.source_excerpt: It's a REST API. JSON in, JSON out.
processes.notes: The Lending service note says: "The lending API is internal-only." The Interview transcript says: "The phones talk straight to the lending API over the internet." These are conflicting positive claims, so exposure is unknown.

processes.name: Self-service kiosk
processes.description: A branch kiosk that scans a member's library card and books and sends loans and returns to the lending API.
processes.source_excerpt: The kiosks are in every branch and they send each loan and each return to the lending API as it is scanned.

data_stores.name: Loans database
data_stores.description: The database containing members, loans, reservations, names, email addresses, home addresses, and full borrowing histories.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Names, email addresses, home addresses and every member's full borrowing history live in the loans database.

data_flows.name: manage loans
data_flows.description: A member uses the library app to borrow, renew, or reserve a book.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Members borrow, renew and reserve books through the library app on their phones.

data_flows.name: change loans
data_flows.description: The library app requests a loan renewal or reservation from the lending API.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The app on their phone calls the lending API. It says which book and which member, and the API checks the loan rules and writes the change.
data_flows.notes: Priya said: "I think it checks a token the app gets at sign-in, but I'd have to look." This is a voiced uncertainty, so authentication remains unknown.
data_flows.data_description: book, member, loan renewal, or reservation request

data_flows.name: send loans and returns
data_flows.description: A self-service kiosk sends each scanned loan and return to the lending API.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The kiosks are in every branch and they send each loan and each return to the lending API as it is scanned.
data_flows.data_description: member card, book, loan, or return information

data_flows.name: update loan account
data_flows.description: Desk staff use the circulation page served by the lending API to extend loans, clear account blocks, or mark books returned.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Desk staff can extend a loan, clear a block on a member's account or mark a book as returned by hand, through a circulation page the lending API serves.
data_flows.notes: Everyone at the desk uses the same shared login for the circulation page. The password is on a card taped under the desk.
data_flows.data_description: member account, loan, return, or account-block changes

data_flows.name: read and write loans
data_flows.description: The lending API reads and writes the loans database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The API is the only thing that reads or writes it.
data_flows.data_description: members, loans, reservations, and borrowing histories

trust_boundaries.name: Branch network
trust_boundaries.description: The network on which branch kiosks and desk staff work.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The kiosks sit on the branch network.

trust_boundaries.name: Council data centre
trust_boundaries.description: The council data centre where the lending API and loans database run.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The lending API and the loans database run in the council data centre.

assumptions.assumption: The loans database is confidential because it contains names, email addresses, home addresses, and members' full borrowing histories.
assumptions.basis: The Interview transcript states that these personal details and borrowing histories live in the loans database.

assumptions.assumption: The library app presents a non-web interface because it is described as an app on a phone rather than a web application.
assumptions.basis: The Interview transcript states: "The app on their phone calls the lending API."

assumptions.assumption: The self-service kiosk presents a non-web interface because it is described as a physical self-service kiosk rather than a web application.
assumptions.basis: The sources describe self-service kiosks where members scan their cards and books.
